issue_body:
### What happened?

We have cluster with 3 nodes: leader, sync and async replicas. After add standby leader and restart postgres in patronictl list one of replica show as Sync Standby, but in pg_stat_replication it's async for all.

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

patronictl pause
pg_ctl stop (on each node)
add standby leader in patroni.yaml
pg_ctl start
patronictl resume
patronictl list

| Member        | Host          | Role           | State     | TL | Lag in MB |


+---------------+---------------+----------------+-----------+----+-----------+


| host1 | 10.1.1.1 | Standby Leader | streaming | 59 |           |


| host2 | 10.1.1.2 | Replica        | streaming | 59 |         0 |


| host3 | 10.1.1.3| Sync Standby   | streaming | 59 |         0 |


+---------------+---------------+----------------+-----------+----+-----------+

### What did you expect to happen?

role for replica = Replica

### Patroni/PostgreSQL/DCS version

-   Patroni version: 3.2.2
-   PostgreSQL version:  15.5
-   DCS (and its version): etcd 3.5.0


### Patroni configuration file

```yaml

name: host2

restapi:

    host    all             zbx_monitor     127.0.0.1/32            trust  
   local   all             all                                     peer  
    host    all             all             127.0.0.1/32            scram-sha-256

    host    replication     repl            204/32        trust

    backup-map      postgres               backup

bin_dir: /opt/pgpro/ent-15/bin


pgpass: /var/lib/postgresql/.pgpass


use_unix_socket: true
use_unix_socket_repl: true
authentication:

username: repl
password: repl1
superuser:
username: postgres
assword: postgres
parameters:
unix_socket_directories: '/tmp'
basebackup:
    waldir: /pgdata/pg_wal/drdb

nofailover: false
noloadbalance: false
clonefrom: false
nosync: false
patroni
level: DEBUG
```
